proof_body:
by
  intro U hU hs hne
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, a ∉ U := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hne (Set.eq_univ_of_forall h)
  have hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => z - a) U := differentiableOn_id.sub_const a
  have h0 : ∀ z ∈ U, z - a ≠ 0 := fun z hz h => ha (by rwa [← sub_eq_zero.mp h])
  obtain ⟨l, hl1, hl2⟩ := Complex.exists_continuousOn_eqOn_exp_comp hs hU hg.continuousOn (by
    rintro ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩
    exact h0 z hz hz0)
  have hld : DifferentiableOn ℂ l U := by
    intro z hz
    have hzn := hU.mem_nhds hz
    have hfc : ContinuousAt l z := hl1.continuousAt hzn
    have hgz := hg.differentiableAt hzn
    have hq : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => Complex.log ((w - a) / (z - a))) z := by
      apply DifferentiableAt.clog (hgz.div_const _)
      simp [div_self (h0 z hz)]
    have hev : l =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => l z + Complex.log ((w - a) / (z - a)) := by
      have hsmall : ∀ᶠ w in nhds z, ‖l w - l z‖ < Real.pi := by
        have : Filter.Tendsto (fun w => ‖l w - l z‖) (nhds z) (nhds ‖l z - l z‖) := (hfc.sub continuousAt_const).norm
        simp only [sub_self, norm_zero] at this
        exact this.eventually (gt_mem_nhds Real.pi_pos)
      filter_upwards [hsmall, hzn] with w hw hwU
      have e : (w - a) / (z - a) = Complex.exp (l w - l z) := by
        rw [Complex.exp_sub]
        have a1 : Complex.exp (l w) = w - a := hl2 hwU
        have a2 : Complex.exp (l z) = z - a := hl2 hz
        rw [a1, a2]
      have him : |(l w - l z).im| < Real.pi := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hw
      rw [e, Complex.log_exp (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp him).1]) (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp him).2])]
      ring
    exact ((differentiableAt_const _).add hq).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev |>.differentiableWithinAt
  set s : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Complex.exp (l z / 2) with hsdef
  have hsd : DifferentiableOn ℂ s U := (hld.div_const _).cexp
  have hsq : ∀ z ∈ U, s z ^ 2 = z - a := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [hsdef]
    rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    have : ((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (l z / 2) = l z := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this]
    exact hl2 hz
  have hs0 : ∀ z, s z ≠ 0 := fun z => Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  have hsinj : Set.InjOn s U := by
    intro x hx y hy h
    have := hsq x hx
    rw [h, hsq y hy] at this
    exact (sub_left_injective this).symm
  have hsderiv : ∀ z ∈ U, deriv s z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz h
    have hzn := hU.mem_nhds hz
    have h1 : HasDerivAt s (deriv s z) z := (hsd.differentiableAt hzn).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun w => s w ^ 2) ((2 : ℕ) * s z ^ (2 - 1) * deriv s z) z := h1.fun_pow 2
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun w => s w ^ 2) 1 z := by
      have e : (fun w => s w ^ 2) =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => w - a := by
        filter_upwards [hzn] with w hw using hsq w hw
      exact ((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const a).congr_of_eventuallyEq e
    have := h2.unique h3
    rw [h] at this
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hs.nonempty
  have hz₀n := hU.mem_nhds hz₀
  have hmap : s '' U ∈ nhds (s z₀) := by
    have ha' := hsd.analyticAt hz₀n
    rw [← ha'.hasStrictDerivAt.map_nhds_eq (hsderiv z₀ hz₀)]
    exact Filter.image_mem_map hz₀n
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hmap
  have hfar : ∀ z ∈ U, ε ≤ ‖s z + s z₀‖ := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    have hm : -s z ∈ Metric.ball (s z₀) ε := by
      rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
      have : -s z - s z₀ = -(s z + s z₀) := by ring
      rw [this, norm_neg]
      exact hlt
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hye⟩ := hball hm
    have h1 : s y ^ 2 = s z ^ 2 := by rw [hye]; ring
    rw [hsq y hy, hsq z hz] at h1
    have h2 : y = z := sub_left_injective h1
    rw [h2] at hye
    have h3 : s z = 0 := by
      have : (2 : ℂ) * s z = 0 := by linear_combination hye
      simpa using this
    exact hs0 z h3
  have hne2 : ∀ z ∈ U, s z + s z₀ ≠ 0 := fun z hz h => by
    have := hfar z hz
    rw [h, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hsadd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => s z + s z₀) U := hsd.add_const _
  set c₀ : ℂ := ((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) with hc₀
  have hc₀ne : c₀ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hc₀]
    exact_mod_cast (by positivity : ε / 2 ≠ 0)
  refine ⟨fun z => c₀ / (s z + s z₀), DifferentiableOn.div (differentiableOn_const _) hsadd hne2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_div]
    have hp : 0 < ‖s z + s z₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne2 z hz)
    rw [div_lt_one hp, hc₀, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have := hfar z hz
    linarith
  · intro x hx y hy h
    simp only at h
    have h1 := hne2 x hx
    have h2 := hne2 y hy
    rw [div_eq_div_iff h1 h2] at h
    have h3 := mul_left_cancel₀ hc₀ne h
    exact hsinj hx hy (add_right_cancel h3.symm)
  · intro z hz h
    have hzn := hU.mem_nhds hz
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => s w + s z₀) (deriv s z) z := (hsd.differentiableAt hzn).hasDerivAt.add_const _
    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_const z c₀).div h1 (hne2 z hz)
    have h3 := HasDerivAt.deriv h2
    have h4 : deriv (fun z => c₀ / (s z + s z₀)) z = (0 * (s z + s z₀) - c₀ * deriv s z) / (s z + s z₀) ^ 2 := h3
    rw [h4] at h
    have h5 := pow_ne_zero 2 (hne2 z hz)
    rw [div_eq_zero_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · simp only [zero_mul, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact hc₀ne h
      · exact hsderiv z hz h
    · exact h5 h
target_source: ∀ (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U → IsSimplyConnected U → U ≠ Set.univ → ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U ∧ Set.MapsTo f U (Metric.ball 0 1) ∧ Set.InjOn f U ∧ ∀ z ∈ U, deriv f z ≠ 0
